input.overview: For {duration}, some shoppers on io-shop could not open their account pages. At the worst minute, {peak_error_rate} of requests were failing. The trouble started when a new monthly-spending feature was switched on for the account pages. The feature runs a calculation that fails for any shopper with no purchases in the current month, so their account pages would not load. The shoppers affected were likely those who have bought from the shop before but not this month. Argus estimates the shop lost {customer_loss} in takings. Nobody was paged, so no one on call was pulled in to respond. Argus switched the new feature back off, but that did not help, so Argus turned it back on. Argus has also written a proposed fix. It is still a draft and has not yet been applied.
